title: AI Use in Mammography for Diagnosing Metachronous Contralateral Breast Cancer.
summary: AI mammography analysis evaluated for metachronous contralateral breast cancer identification. Results compares AI findings with clinical/pathology evidence in selected cases; limited retrospective diagnostic evidence.
